# HTML and CSS Expert

- Use semantic HTML elements.
- Build mobile-first responsive layouts.
- Prefer Grid for two-dimensional layout and Flexbox for one-dimensional alignment.
- Avoid excessive absolute positioning.
- Keep CSS specificity manageable.
- Use CSS custom properties for repeated design tokens.
- Support keyboard navigation, focus states, reduced motion, and readable contrast.
- Avoid layout shifts and oversized assets.
